dependency_decision.approach: Reuse the published owner's exact Buf/Protobuf-ES/Connect versions; no floating upgrade. Protobuf-ES v2 emits service descriptors consumed by Connect createClient.
dependency_decision.alternatives: Handwritten DTO/RPC serializers duplicate the owner contract; copying owner runtime/generated files lacks an independent reproducible consumer generation chain.
dependency_decision.supply_chain: Exact package versions and lock integrity; local generation without remote plugins; only @bufbuild/buf install build is newly allowed.
dependency_decision.performance: No network calls or application startup added. Runtime performance is unmeasured; this slice validates descriptor serialization only.
dependency_decision.failure_semantics: Generation rejects source/config/package/tree/digest drift. No retry, authentication, command digest or production adapter is implemented.
dependency_decision.exit_path: Regenerate from the pinned owner Proto with a reviewed compatible generator; generated wire types remain isolated from business code.
